analysis: Documentation-only changes in docs/architecture/inference.md. Visible changed head ranges: 5230-5235 (cluster runtime approval digests are now computed by the signed release from its own final app and registered as `cluster_runtime`, with guided setup matching a served approval through the same computation, replacing the setup-time registration) and 5250-5284 (pair-serving grants, ClusterPublicModels declarations with evidence SHA-256, member capabilities limited to hardware flags, and coordinator refusal of pair sessions without a grant or outside the granted mode families, citing immutable darkbloom-platform links). The text describes the artifact/qualification contract (A-017, T-054, TB-011) and coordinator-side enforcement that the platform owns. It claims no new local trust and no weakening of verification: files are still verified by DistributedInstalledFiles.verify, capability digests by DistributedCapabilityProbe.verify, and resource policy by NativePairMemberPolicy.require. The statement at 5277-5279, that a coordinator applies declared parity qualifications to the whole family on any Apple silicon pair, is a policy description of platform behavior; the backend implementation is outside the supplied evidence. Ranges 3528-3536 (health file separation), 5291-5294 and 5370-5372 were not in these units and appear only in the patch excerpt; the health-file text is an availability and liveness detail with no evident security regression. The unchanged sections reviewed include Qwen media ingress (prefix reuse disabled, T-041), the TP context charge and the tenant-partitioned prefix tiers; none show a regression. No source code was supplied. The release-computed approval registration relies on the release lane's integrity (A-005/A-011-style release authority), which is a coordinator and platform contract and cannot be verified here.
